chapters.reason: LaTRO uses variational approaches and EM-style iterations to progressively refine reasoning, aligning with step-by-step internalization and iterative updating.
The framework formulates reasoning as sampling from a latent distribution and optimizes it via variational methods, targeting internal states rather than explicit tokens.
LaTRO improves reasoning quality without external feedback, suggesting semantic anchoring through self-improvement, though not explicitly compressing full traces.
